title: SynthUX Synthetic Participant
description: A synthetic usability-test participant: demographic identity drawn from a persona dataset, plus a behavioural augmentation layer sampled per participant. Demographics condition behaviour distributions; they never determine behaviour deterministically.

persona_id.description: Stable id, e.g. IND_04381. Frozen panels reuse these ids across regression runs.

license.description: e.g. CC-BY-4.0. Commercial path requires a commercially usable license.

cohorts.description: Study-level cohort tags this participant aggregates under, e.g. ['55+', 'low_digital_literacy']. Assigned by the persona generator from demographics + behaviour.

behaviour.description: The behavioural augmentation layer. All dimensions are 0–1 floats sampled from cohort-conditioned distributions with per-participant noise.

domain_expertise.description: Knowledge of the product's domain vocabulary (e.g. 'mandate').

reading_patience.description: Willingness to read body text vs. skim labels only.

exploration.description: Tendency to try unfamiliar paths. Also drives sampling temperature.

risk_tolerance.description: Willingness to click when consequences are unclear.

help_seeking.description: Propensity to open Help/Search when stuck.

error_recovery.description: Ability to recognise a wrong path and backtrack productively.

trust.description: Baseline trust in the product; low trust abandons at scary steps (payments, permissions).

working_memory_items.description: Max observations retained between steps. Expert ≈ 8, average ≈ 4, distracted ≈ 2–3.

decay_per_step.description: Salience decay applied to each remembered observation per action step.

viewport_only.description: Hard constraint: content below the fold is unknown until scrolled. Always true.

accessibility.description: Perceptual constraints applied at the world-model layer (element visibility/legibility degraded before the agent sees the screen).

sampling.description: Frozen per participant so regression panels are replayable.

narrative.description: 1–3 sentence background used verbatim in the synthetic-user prompt. No behavioural claims here — behaviour lives in the dimensions above.
